purpose: State that an event or explanation is not possible.
keywords: It is impossible to be in two places at that time.
Success is impossible under these conditions.
I cannot conceive of a proposal that satisfies everyone at once.
restrictions: 得ない is read えない and concerns possibility, not personal skill.
mistake: Do not read the negative as うない.

segments.role: State that an event or explanation is not possible. Vます stem + 得ない
